lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately four horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank, with a central cluster of roughly 5-7 prominent spots forming a triangular grouping posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern where high-intensity blobs are positioned both within and between the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal side) to shadow (ventral side).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, lower-intensity circular blobs visible across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
